medium.title: Ahead of Market: 10 Things That Will Decide D-Street Action on Monday
medium.summary:
The Sensex surged over 960 points and the Nifty climbed more than 1% on Friday, buoyed by strong Q1 earnings optimism and broad-based buying in IT and banking stocks. Domestic institutional investors (DIIs) appear to be rotating into attractively valued large-cap names, providing a supportive demand backdrop for equities heading into Monday's session. Selective profit-booking continues in mid- and small-cap segments, suggesting some caution beneath the headline rally. Consumer durables stocks are also attracting interest on the back of improving demand expectations. For fund managers, the DII-led rotation into large-caps — particularly in banking — is a key trend to monitor, as sustained inflows into financials could provide indirect support to broader risk sentiment and INR stability. Watch for any continuation of earnings surprises in the banking sector that could further drive index-level moves.
